lines.label: Change
lines.note: Renamed to Soaring Slam from Tremors.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Rammus dash to the target location with cc-immune, and upon impact he deals 100–250 (3 ranks) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slow them by 15–20 (3 ranks)% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies in the center take increased damage if Soaring Slam was cast further than 600 units, capped at 1700 units with 50% increased damage. If Soaring Slam is cast while channeling Powerball}}, enemies within the center of the impact are also airborne for 0.75 seconds and take collision damage. Powerball}} will not collide with enemies during the dash, and its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Rammus' impact causes 3 aftershocks to burst from the area over 3.5 seconds. Each aftershock deals 20–40 (3 ranks) (+ 10% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area and applies the initial slow, which stacks up to 4 times.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Soaring Slam's damage applies to and is doubled against structures.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Soaring Slam's minimum cast range is 600 units and is also equal to 130% of his average movement speed over the past 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Soaring Slam's center radius is 200 units and its slam and aftershock radius are 400 units.
